name: Area 47 Lodges
beschreibung: The Area 47 Lodges are run as an inn in Tyrol, Austria. The lodge combines overnight accommodations with the adjacent Area 47 outdoor adventure park. The facilities include a traditional dining room serving regional dishes. The accommodations are designed for families and active holidaymakers alike. The location provides direct access to climbing areas and water worlds. The rooms feature modern amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi. The property is well suited for stays focusing on both adventure and recreation.
